runbooks.title: Blocking schema migration
runbooks.body: Symptoms: sessions waiting on a lock held by a DDL statement, lock timeouts on writes, CPU normal. Steps: identify the blocking session in pg_stat_activity; cancel the migration backend with pg_cancel_backend; set lock_timeout on the migration role; pause the deploy pipeline. Rebuilding the index with CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY is a human decision.

runbooks.title: Roll back the application deploy
runbooks.body: Redeploy the previous inventory-service release when a code change caused the regression. NOT effective when the change is a database migration that is still running -- rolling back application code does not release its lock.

runbooks.title: Restart the connection pooler
runbooks.body: Restart PgBouncer to clear stuck client connections. Drops every in-flight transaction - not for sessions blocked on a table lock.
